fieldview-motion.intent: Pure motion library: accel-limited kinematics, multi-waypoint cuts, non-naive defender pursuit, animated disc flight. Transient state; no Scene or format change.

signals.message: MotionParams gained a 4th tunable: lead (seconds, default 0.6, range 0-1.5). Partition 2 found the 3-param cushion model insufficient — without a velocity-projected lead, a defender deep on a cutter breaking deep drifts UNDER to reclaim its cushion instead of turning and carrying the cut, failing PRD FR-3.4. Touches P1 files (motion/types.ts, motion/constants.ts) from the P2 branch. Impact: Partition 4's Movement slider group covers accel, decel, cushion, lead; prefs.ts validation/clamping must include lead. Also resolves the PRD open question 'whether cushion magnitude varies with the cutter's speed' — it does not; cushion is fixed and lead scales with speed.

feat/fieldview-motion-core.intent: Pure kinematics: Mover/MotionState types, motion tunables, Vec2 math, accel-limited arrive() with braking, multi-waypoint route sequencing, purity guard test

feat/fieldview-motion-pursuit.intent: Cushion pursuit model on a reaction delay, step() as the single physics entry point, headless simulate() producing a Trajectory

feat/fieldview-motion-driver.intent: Fixed-timestep accumulator driving step() off rAF, writing through store.mutate; transient motion mode state; run/stop/reset; reduced-motion path

feat/fieldview-motion-ui.intent: Route section in the offense panel, destination picking and draggable markers in FieldCanvas, routeLayer, Movement sliders, motion params persisted in prefs

feat/fieldview-motion-disc.intent: Animated disc flight timed by the space model's flightTime(); possession changes on arrival, not on click
